title: Yomi's Minecraft Transit Railway
description: A fixed and enhanced fork of Minecraft-Transit Railway mod version 3.2.2-1.20.1.
body:
# Yomi's Minecraft Transit Railway

## English
This is an **unofficial fork** of [Minecraft Transit Railway (MTR)](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-transit-railway) mod, specifically for **version 1.20.1‑3.2.2**. It fixes long‑standing bugs unique to this version and adds useful new features.

> Note: If you want to use this mod together with **JCM**, please install [the special compatibility version](https://modrinth.com/project/GuxlRbJ2).


### Added Features

- **Manual driving enhancements**  
  - MTR4‑style dashboard and alignment bar (gradually approaches from the top)  
  - Distance to next station (in meters) always visible  
  - After passing a station, the alignment bar automatically switches to the next stop

- **Train operations**  
  - **Early braking: Trains decelerate in advance so that speed drops to the limit precisely when entering a restricted track – switchable per siding**
  - **Waiting time after door closing**

- **Rendering**  
  - **Vehicle render distance is now independent from simulation distance – fully adjustable on its own**
  - More realistic SP1900 train texture (same as MTR4)

- **Lift improvements**  
  - Adjustable acceleration and maximum speed  
  - Choose between transparent or opaque lift styles
  - Redesigned two-column lift settings panel

- **Broadcaster**  
  - Supports playing network audio (`.wav` format only for now)


### Fixed Issues

- Lift doors and platform doors can now be placed, opened, and broken **properly (original MTR 3.2.2-1.20 bug)**
- Railway nodes no longer drop items when touching water  
- **Items have their own creative mode tab (not forced into Redstone tab)**
- Fixed severe rendering conflicts with shaders (PIDS, etc.)
- Improved compatibility with ANTE and ANTE FIX

### Credits

Fork and enhancements by Yomi_307.  
Original mod by [Jonathan Ho](https://modrinth.com/user/cVv3etVW) ([Minecraft Transit Railway](https://modrinth.com/project/XKPAmI6u)).

---

## 中文

这是 **Minecraft Transit Railway (MTR)** 模组的**非官方分支**，专门针对1.20.1。
本分支修复了该版本独有的长期遗留问题，并添加了诸多实用的新功能。

> 注意：如果你想将此模组与 **JCM** 一同使用，请安装[特殊兼容版本](https://modrinth.com/project/GuxlRbJ2)。


### 新增功能

- **手动驾驶增强**  
  - MTR4 风格的仪表盘和对标条（逐渐从上方靠近）  
  - 始终显示到下一站的距离（米）  
  - 通过车站后，对标条自动切换至下一站

- **列车运行**  
  - **提前减速：列车提前开始减速，确保车头驶入限速轨道时速度刚好降至目标速度——可按侧线单独开关**
  - **停站关门后等待时间**

- **渲染**  
  - **载具渲染距离现已独立于模拟距离——可单独完全调节**
  - 更逼真的 SP1900 列车贴图（与 MTR4 相同）

- **电梯改进**  
  - 可调节加速度和最大速度  
  - 可在透明或不透明电梯风格之间选择
  - 重新设计的双列电梯设置面板

- **广播器**  
  - 支持播放网络音频（目前仅支持 `.wav` 格式）


### 修复问题

- 电梯门和屏蔽门现在可以**正常**放置、打开和破坏（原版 MTR 3.2.2-1.20 的 bug）
- 铁路节点碰到水不再掉落
- **物品拥有独立的创造模式物品栏标签页（不再归入红石标签页）**
- 修复了与光影（PIDS 等）的渲染冲突
- 改进了与 ANTE 和 ANTE FIX 的兼容性

### 致谢

本分支由 Yomi_307 制作。  
原模组由 [Jonathan Ho](https://modrinth.com/user/cVv3etVW)（[Minecraft Transit Railway](https://modrinth.com/project/XKPAmI6u)）创作。
